title: Generic-point product description of the meromorphic sheaf
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let X^0 be the set of generic points [def-sc-generic-point] of the irreducible components [def-weil-irreducible-components] of X. Assume (a) every weakly associated point of X is the generic point of an irreducible component, where a point is weakly associated when the maximal ideal of its local ring is weakly associated to that local ring, meaning it is minimal among the prime ideals containing the annihilator of some element, and (b) every quasi-compact open of X has finitely many irreducible components. Let K_X be the sheaf obtained by localizing O_X at its non-zero-divisors, and let F be a quasi-coherent O_X-module [pqf-def-coherent]. For each generic point eta write j_eta: Spec(O_{X,eta}) \to X for the canonical morphism. Then K_X = product_{eta in X^0} j_{eta,*} O_{X,eta} and K_X(F) = K_X tensor_{O_X} F = product_{eta in X^0} j_{eta,*} F_eta.

proof.text: Construct the map from the meromorphic localization presheaf to each generic-point pushforward. The source sends m/b to the germ of m divided by the germ of b. The spectrum of a generic stalk is a singleton, so its local ring has Krull dimension zero and every regular germ is a unit. If the generic point is outside an open, the target sections are zero. Use the fraction formula supplied by the existing public exists_meromorphicRestriction theorem via choose_spec, and prove restriction compatibility by multiplying by the invertible denominator. Extend each presheaf map across sheafification and take Pi.lift. The extension property proves the required formula on ordinary sections.

For an affine open U, apply lem-sc-meromorphic-affine-generic-sections to the component of the presheaf product map; the hypothesis hfinite supplies finiteness of components because affine opens are compact. Its normalization is exactly Step 1. To glue, prove local injectivity and local surjectivity of the presheaf map by shrinking to affine neighborhoods and using its bijective component. The sheafification unit is locally bijective, so its extension is locally bijective between sheaves and therefore an isomorphism.

Construct a linear equivalence from the unit module stalk to the structure ring stalk using preservation of filtered colimits by the forgetful functor from commutative rings through rings to abelian groups. Its formula on germs and the stalk scalar action prove linearity. Apply tilde and pushforward to identify the generic factors for the unit with the structure sheaf factors. Naturality of tilde.toOpen and the explicit fromSpecStalk app formula identify the resulting composite with unitToPushforwardObjUnit. Apply the product isomorphism from Step 2 to the unit and compose with Pi.mapIso of these factor isomorphisms.

On each open, construct the equivalence LocalizedModule(S,R) tensor_R M = LocalizedModule(S,M) using LocalizedModule.equivTensorProduct and the tensor right unitor. Its formula (a/b) tensor m maps to (a*m)/b proves naturality under restriction by tensor and localization induction. Sheafify this presheaf isomorphism and compose the monoidal sheafification tensorator with the counit isomorphism on F. This gives the tensor clause for every module F, independently of hweak, hfinite, or quasi-coherence. Combine with Step 2 for F and Step 3 for the unit to obtain the three original clauses.

lean.statement: theorem meromorphicModule_generic_product (X : Scheme.{u}) (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] (hweak : ∀ x : X, IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x) ∈ Ideal.WeakAss (X.presheaf.stalk x) → x ∈ genericPoints X) (hfinite : ∀ U : X.Opens, IsCompact (U : Set X) → (irreducibleComponents U).Finite) : (∃ e : meromorphicModule X (unit X) ≅ ∏ᶜ (fun η : {x : X // x ∈ genericPoints X} ↦ (pushforward (X.fromSpecStalk η.val)).obj (unit (Spec (X.presheaf.stalk η.val)))), ∀ η : {x : X // x ∈ genericPoints X}, toMeromorphicModule X (unit X) ≫ e.hom ≫ Pi.π _ η = SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit (X.fromSpecStalk η.val).toRingCatSheafHom) ∧ Nonempty ((meromorphicModule X (unit X) ⊗ F) ≅ meromorphicModule X F) ∧ (∃ e : meromorphicModule X F ≅ ∏ᶜ (fun η : {x : X // x ∈ genericPoints X} ↦ (pushforward (X.fromSpecStalk η.val)).obj (tilde (ModuleCat.of (X.presheaf.stalk η.val) (F.presheaf.stalk η.val)))), ∀ (η : {x : X // x ∈ genericPoints X}) (U : X.Opens) (hη : η.val ∈ U) (m : Γ(F, U)), (toMeromorphicModule X F ≫ e.hom ≫ Pi.π _ η).val.app (op U) m = tilde.toOpen (ModuleCat.of (X.presheaf.stalk η.val) (F.presheaf.stalk η.val)) (X.fromSpecStalk η.val ⁻¹ᵁ U) (F.presheaf.germ U η.val hη m))
